newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Santos completes MIM oil, gas buy.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Santos completes MIM oil, gas buy.

text.p: Oil and gas producer Santos Ltd said on Wednesday its acquisition of the oil and gas businesses of MIM Holdings Ltd has been completed.

This followed the issue of petroleum development licences for the South East Gobe development in Papua New Guinea, where Santos would hold a seven percent interest, and Bank of Papua New Guinea approval, it said in a statement.
Santos said it had created a new Southeast Asia business unit to carry on the former MIM business, focussing on exploration in Southeast Asia.

The former general manager of MIM Petroleum Exploration Pty Ltd, Robert Hall, would head the unit as general manager, and other former MIM staff would also continue with the unit to be based in Brisbane, Santos said.
MIM announced in September last year that it would sell its oil and gas business to Santos for A$45.1 million.
